Explore the pros, cons and trends of investment property. Find out why DarGlobal's handpicked projects provide both lifestyle perfection and capital appreciation.
Is buying a home a good investment? Pros, cons, trends, and alternatives
Home buying was always viewed as a conservative means of accumulating wealth. However, in the world we are in today, the choice is more complicated than ever before. Some view homes as a means of living comfortably, while for others, they are viewed more as an investment. A home offers rental income, financial security, and appreciation in the future, but it also presents risk and responsibilities.
DarGlobal offers international investors an opportunity to invest in handpicked residential properties such as
Marea, Interiors by Missoni
Sunrise Haven
Neptune Interiors by Mouawad
, in global cities. Such properties offer architectural perfection with the prospect of high capital appreciation. In this blog, we will explore why buying a home is a good investment, its advantages, disadvantages, and latest trends.
Key Takeaways
This blog explores why a home is a good investment and what it implies in today's real estate market.
Buying a home investment means acquiring wealth through rental income, value appreciation, or a blend of both.
Chief advantages are rental income, tax benefits, portfolio diversification, appreciation in the long term, etc.
Smart home, sustainability, and lifestyle transformation are major present-day trends defining real estate investment.
First-timers are allowed to enter the investment market, though they pay higher down payments and have stricter loan requirements.
Assessing for readiness, funds availability, placement, and extended costs determines whether homeownership is a good option or not.
Buying a home as an investment entails the purchase of a home for wealth generation and not for residential purposes alone. It can be for the generation of income through rents, earnings through appreciation in property prices, or taking advantage of available credit opportunities in a bid to generate higher returns in the future.
For example, high-end properties of DarGlobal in international centers offer investors a lifestyle and future appreciation in the long term. Such properties as Marea, Interiors by Missoni, or Sunrise Haven not only provide accommodation space but are also assets with international demand and future appreciation.
Advantages of a home investment extend beyond mere ownership. A good home can deliver financial, personal, and lifestyle value.
Renting Income Possibility:
It is possible for residential homes to generate steady passive income. As economies mature, rents continue to rise, thus properties are predictable for cash flow. DarGlobal residential properties in global hubs are bound to attract both short-term and long-stay tenants.
Tax Benefits and Incentives:
Real estate investors may be entitled to tax deductions, which would lower the overall expenses, making investing in real estate more appealing than other investment vehicles.
Diversification and Decreased Risk:
Real estate provides portfolio diversification through less risk from the volatility of the stock market. Real estate assets provide stability in times of uncertainty.
Long-Term Appreciation of Value:
Real estate, particularly in major international centers, appreciates over the long run. As DarGlobal offers luxurious homes in global locations carries a high potential for capital appreciation.
Return on Investment:
Unlike many assets, real estate can provide both ongoing income and future profits when sold.
Capital and Leverage:
You can invest with a partial down payment and finance the rest, making it possible to build wealth with limited initial capital.
Real estate markets are transforming fast with technological, economic, and lifestyle transformations. Hence, it is essential to know about the upcoming trends to select the perfect Adobe.
Technological Change:
Computer-generated valuation, virtual tours, and tech-savvy homes integrated with Smart Devices are the modern trend. DarGlobal targets these smart aspects of home design that attract technology-conscious consumers.
Economic Change:
Increasing interest rates and inflation affect building prices and lending rates. Thus, investors these days seek stable, top-notch projects located in international hotspots.
Lifestyle Change:
Rise of demand in green housing, including sustainable features. Sustainable material and energy-efficiently designed homes, such as DarGlobal homes, are in high demand among conscientious buyers.
Luxury Market Growth:
Ultra-high-net-worth individuals favor high-end housing and branded residences. Luxury residential properties like Marea, Interiors by Missoni, and Neptune Interiors by Mouawad represent the increased desire for high-end residential properties with wellness facilities.
Pandemic Effect:
Telecommuting tendencies have altered demand in favor of homes with big spaces, wellness centers, and outdoor views. Such transformed lifestyle needs are catered to by DarGlobal in all its projects.
For first-time buyers, one question that keeps bothering them is “
making a first purchase in a residential property is attainable but requires strategic planning. Higher deposits, stricter credit requirements, and slightly higher rates are deterrents. They are, however, balanced by possibilities for steady rental income and long-term appreciation in equity.
DarGlobal projects
open up this route more easily through properties around the world for lifestyle and investment. Through their luxurious projects, buyers not only acquire a home but also step into the world of the property investment arena with reputable value.
If you want to evaluate “
must consider personal, monetary, and market aspects to make a good investment.
Assess Your Readiness & Lifestyle:
Plan for the long haul. Will you be staying in the location for 3–5 years? Do you accept maintenance responsibilities?
Assess Current Situation:
Consider your budget, down payment ability, and credit record. You also must possess an emergency fund subsequent to a purchase.
Do Your Research:
Choose locations with high lifestyle appeal and future appreciation prospects. Such properties located in global hubs and developed with keeping new-age requirements in mind are some properties you can consider.
Understand the Full Cost of Homeownership:
Pay attention to taxes, insurance, and maintenance, as they are just as important an expense as the price of the property.
Seek Professional Help:
You need qualified real estate professionals, lenders, and home inspectors on your side to make the best-informed decision.
Investing in a residential property can be a successful investment, but it takes strategic planning, financial preparations, and clear objectives. Also, trending changes like sustainability, smart living, and lifestyle amenities influence the investor's mindset towards real estate.
DarGlobal offers investors homes that are thoughtfully curated and integrate wellness, luxury, and promise value appreciation in the long run. With these properties, investors can benefit not only from monetary growth but can also get a luxurious lifestyle in the world's demanding hubs.
Buying a home is not always a good investment. Cautious research is important for a property investment. A real estate investment flourishes when strategically chosen, considering location, demand, and prospects in the market.
Whether you buy a second home or invest in stocks is based on your own goals. Real estate gives more security and generates rental income, while stocks provide liquidity.
Yes, a first-time home buyer can buy an investment property, but it may require a larger down payment and stricter credit. Although you will have an extra challenge here, income from rents and appreciation may balance these challenges and support future wealth creation.
Some of the risk factors of investing in an investment home are market downtimes, high maintenance, and vacancy. Careful site and property selection minimizes such risks.
Real estate is a form of investment, indeed, as it can provide rental income, current equity growth, long-term value growth, and tax benefits.
title: Is Buying a Home a Good Investment? Pros, Cons, Trends & Alternatives

Dubai 2040: The Roadmap to a Smart & Sustainable City
Dubai has long been celebrated for its futuristic vision and luxurious skyline. In an effort to enhance the city's appeal and offer its residents an even better quality of life, the
Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan
was developed. This ambitious initiative aims to make Dubai one of the world's most innovative and most sustainable cities.
It is one of the most futuristic plans that outlines how the city will be developed over the next fifteen years. It emphasizes environmental friendliness, smart technology, sustainability, and enhancing the quality of life for residents and visitors.
Through projects like
Da Vinci Tower Interiors By Pagani
and
D-Villas At Jumeirah Golf Estates
, Dubai's luxury estate developers, such as DarGlobal, are reinforcing this vision by building innovative and sustainable developments. In this blog, we will examine the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan and its potential to shape a better future for residents and investors alike.
Dubai 2040 is a plan that projects how Dubai will develop over a period of next 15 years.
Dubai plans for 60% of its land to be covered with green spaces and nature reserves.
The city will prioritize smart infrastructure with the help of AI and IoT technologies.
Community development will offer alternate housing and lifestyle choices.
Mobility will be promoted through expanded public transport and green networks.
DarGlobal is strengthening this vision with high-end developments like DG1 Living
Da Vinci Towe
r I
nteriors By Pagan
, and D-Villas At Jumeirah Golf Estates.
Dubai 2040 is a long-term master urban plan aimed at doubling the green zone size, enhancing mobility, and providing additional housing for an expanding population. It is significant because it represents a commitment to building an economically diverse, resilient, and liveable city.
The plan focuses on improving the quality of life through enhanced leisure spaces, easy access to public transportation, and affordability. It also ensures that infrastructure and resources are adequate for the future.
The Urban Master Plan covers Dubai's entire geographical area from the city center to the surrounding areas like Hatta. It is the seventh master plan since 1960 and is prepared on key policy guidelines, spatial plans, and projections and targets Dubai's growing population.
Focus is on developing five urban centers with each sector having a specific role, like business, culture, or recreation, that will balance growth. DarGlobal projects are designed through this master plan and yield communities that support economic growth and individual happiness.
Dubai Vision 2040 is established on a number of key objectives discussed below. Pillars are aligned to make Dubai a more attractive destination to work, invest, and live.
One of the key points in favor of Dubai 2040 is that it intends to cover
of the land with green or natural spaces. These spaces include nature parks, nature reserves, and open spaces. The concept is to increase outdoor living and better air quality.
The spaces will be well-connected to residential spaces so that it will be easy for families to have access to open spaces. To adhere to the plan, DarGlobal incorporates landscaped terraces, green corridors, and open public spaces in its projects so that people can live close to nature even in urban areas.
Dubai's future lies in its ability to become more efficient through the implementation of smart solutions. Vision 2040 introduces AI-powered systems for traffic management, energy, and public utilities. Smart grids, real-time monitoring, and IoT networks will be integrated into city operations.
DarGlobal accelerates this transition through intelligent building design, digital governance functions, and energy-efficient building. Projects like
DG1 Living
, and
embody the convergence of comfort and innovation, where smart homes are the new standard in living.
Dubai 2040 recognizes the demand for diverse types of housing. The plan offers access to affordable housing, mid-rise residential, and co-living towers. Health care, shopping, and schools will be walkable from neighborhoods to reduce travel and enhance convenience.
DarGlobal neighborhoods follow these principles by offering mixes of units and amenities that attract families, professionals, and foreign investors looking for lifestyle solutions that integrate living, working, and entertainment.
Transportation is the lifeblood of Dubai's expansion. In 2040,
of the population will be within walking distance of a public transport stop. The city will expand its metro, cycling systems, and footbridge infrastructure.
These measures are intended to discourage the use of automobiles and minimize emissions. That is why DarGlobal chooses locations with direct connections to primary transportation hubs, ensuring that residents can easily move around the city while promoting a cleaner environment.
Dubai aims to become a global business, tourism, and technology hub. The 2040 Plan designates more land for business and opens up the tourism sector.
For example, luxury real estate projects by DarGlobal are designed to attract foreign investors and business professionals. These structures are not just homes, but investments that bring economic potential along with lifestyle excellence.
Vision 2040 master plan has several short-, mid- and long-term targets. These include accepting zoning regulation revisions, introducing infrastructure development, and integrating digital policy.
Dubai will phase in developments to accommodate growth. DarGlobal's approach is aligned with Dubai's phased approach, rolling out projects in prime locations that align with Dubai's vision for long-term development at a spatial level.
Dubai Vision 2040 will help citizens enjoy cleaner air, greenery right at their doorstep, enhanced public transport, and smart utilities. While the investors will benefit from the global attraction of a desirable future-proof city with high liveability.
DarGlobal brings value by offering properties that offer lifestyle value and return on investment, especially as Dubai becomes more appealing to foreign investors who have an interest in sustainability.
Dubai's vision is not an isolated occurrence; it is a worldwide trend in smart urbanism. From carbon footprint reduction to automated services, Dubai is charting the course in next-generation urbanization.
DarGlobal's projects are infused with technology-driven components, placing them in the universal context of international smart cities. This provides international investors with a sense of familiarity and innovation in each project.
Dubai 2040 is not a government vision, although one endorsed by the government. It's a collective journey to a smarter, greener, more inclusive city. It's a bold pledge to balance growth with quality of life.
DarGlobal is a proud partner of this vision, creating properties that are as luxurious as they are sustainable. Developments like
embody the future of Dubai, a city where technology is harnessed with comfort and where investments are the passport to creating enduring value. Whether you have a stake in Dubai as a resident, investor, or guest, Dubai 2040 is your promise to experience the best of city life.
Dubai 2040 is a master plan designed to guide the city’s development over the next decade. The strategy focuses on creating a greener, smarter, and more connected city by 2040.
The urban master plan of Dubai 2040 focuses on constructing green areas, developing transportation, and promoting sustainable urban growth in the long run.
The 2040 Dubai Vision aims to double green spaces, improve transport, expand commercial areas, and encourage the sustainability of every sector.
The Dubai Plan 2040 includes increasing parks, developing smart infrastructure, enhancing mobility, and increasing access to community services.
The Dubai Vision 2040 is important because it places Dubai at the global forefront of livability, sustainability, and smart city innovation to counter anticipated future challenges.

As DarGlobal’s first European luxury residential project, Sidra promises homeowners the opportunity to own a second home in a haven of peace and tranquility in a country that is rapidly becoming the top destination for investment and vacations right in the heart of Europe.

Real Estate Cycle: Understanding the Phases for Smarter Investing
The real estate cycle is a term used by real estate professionals to describe the buying and selling of property. It helps investors and property owners make more informed decisions to buy and sell a property, reducing the risk factor. Each stage of this cycle has its own unique characteristics, including supply, demand, rental appreciation, and building activities, which vary in intensity.
This cycle is also important for real estate developers like DarGlobal, as we strategically time our developments across market cycles and provide solid, high-value properties, such as
Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad
in Saudi and
AIDA
Properties in Oman. Our luxurious properties meet investor requirements at each phase of the real estate cycle. With its timing, quality, and location, DarGlobal offers an opportunity to live a luxurious lifestyle and make informed investments. Let us explore the real estate cycle and how it can help you make smart investment decisions.
A real estate cycle refers to recurring phases of expansion and contraction, associated with real estate values.
Real estate cycles follow a very predictable pattern based on supply, demand, and changing prices.
The real estate cycle consists of four stages: Recovery, Expansion, Hyper Supply, and Recession, which are used to determine when to buy, hold, or sell property.
Every phase of the housing cycle affects investment decisions depending on market performance and timing.
Real estate assets undergo the cycle of purchase, construction, operation, and sale.
Investors can track economic and market indicators to inform their investment choices at each stage.
A real estate cycle refers to the recurring phases of expansion and contraction associated with real estate values, driven by economic, social, and political conditions. It undergoes various phases, including recovery, expansion, hyper supply, and recession.
Thus, understanding this cycle helps investors make informed decisions about when to invest or withdraw from the market, as they comprehend the supply and demand dynamics of the market. Consequently, the cycle is used to forecast periods when property values appreciate or depreciate. It also aids in estimating rental yields and determining when to buy or sell for a profit.
The real estate cycle typically goes through four phases: Recovery, Expansion, Hyper Supply, and Recession. Each of these stages has its own indicators that tell you how the market is behaving.
This is where the market is beginning to gain momentum after slowing down. Demand is slowly rising, but everyone still believes the market is in recession. There is little or no construction, high vacancy, and negative growth in rents. It's a silent turning point, difficult to observe but full of promise for early buyers.
This is the positive phase. The economy is on the upswing, individuals find employment, and housing demand is higher. Occupancy levels increase, rents escalate, and developers start constructing new developments. Property prices also increase during this phase. It's largely the best time to invest in or acquire properties.
Optimism causes overbuilding. There are simply too many new buildings that are entering the market, and demand lags behind supply. Prices then decelerate, vacancy rises, and rental growth falters. Investors must be cautious here and concentrate on maintaining existing assets.
Here, the prices fall, demand dries up, and houses sit empty. It may sound ghastly, but it can be the best time to find undervalued houses if you're ready financially.
Each stage of the housing market cycle has an impact on your investment decision. Let’s have a look at it:
In the recovery stage, one should buy properties at depressed prices and hold them until they appreciate.
Conversely, in the expansion stage, investors need to invest in high-demand locations with high rental yields.
However, during the phase of hyper-supply, you should retain your investments and refrain from making new or risky purchases. Therefore, focus on retaining tenants and optimizing property returns.
But when the housing market is facing recession, you should be wise enough to sell disappointing assets and retain cash until favorable times return. However, many experienced investors also prefer buying property during this time at lower prices.
A real estate asset lifecycle begins at the planning phase, proceeds through maintenance, and culminates in its disposal. It encompasses four primary stages: Planning, Acquisition, Operation, and Disposal. Each stage has a set of activities and goals for both the developer and the investor.
Here investors identify an opportunity, assess its value, obtain the funds, and finalize the purchase.
The building or remodeling is done to prepare the property for renting. It involves permits and managing the project from start to finish.
In this stage the cash flows are derived and can take many years as property owners deal with tenants, collect rent, manage maintenance, and perform day-to-day operations.
Now, you can sell your property to a new owner. Therefore, it’s time to find a buyer, prepare the property for sale, and finalize the sale.
Monitoring the real estate cycle involves tracking the correct indicators. Economic indicators, such as employment growth and GDP, drive real estate demand. The higher people's incomes, the more they purchase or lease homes. Interest rates are also a crucial factor; low rates stimulate buying, while high rates slow the market's pace.
Government policies also have a significant influence on the real estate market cycle. Tax incentives or regulations can spur the market or shut it down. Demographics play a role as well. When populations grow or change, housing demand follows.

Learn how to obtain a Dubai residence visa in 2025, including eligibility, required documents, application process, and how to qualify via property investment.
How To Get A Residence Visa In Dubai: 2025 Requirements, Process, And Documents Needed?
The UAE is now one of the most popular places to live, work, and invest in 2025. Its amazing infrastructure, tax-free policies, and active business mentality make it an excellent place to reside permanently, and that is why you need a UAE residency visa. This enables you to reside in the UAE for a number of years, offering several residency benefits.
We help our prospective investors gain residency visas by purchasing premium properties such as
D-Villas At Jumeirah Golf Estates
Trump International Hotel & Tower
, Dubai and
W Residences
in Dubai, offering luxury living and long-term residency. So keep reading and take a step forward in getting a residency visa in the UAE.
Dubai attracts foreign residents and investors with a long-term stay, a tax-free environment, and a solid infrastructure.
A UAE residence visa enables access, services, and long-term stay, and may be based on employment, business, investment, or family sponsorship.
Spend at least AED 2 million on Dubai real estate and get eligible for a 10-year Golden Visa.
A visa application involves the preparation of documents, obtaining an entry visa, a medical checkup, and obtaining an Emirates ID.
Applicants can check visa status and print visa copies online from official UAE websites using their application or passport numbers.
You may also sponsor relatives, with nominal charges of AED 3,000–7,000 and processing times of 2–10 working days.
A UAE residence visa allows foreign nationals to stay, work, or study in the UAE for a period of 2 to 10 years. A residence visa is different from a visit visa, which is meant for temporary stays.
Most residence visas have a sponsor, i.e., a company or a UAE resident, who is liable for your stay. However, there are exceptions, such as the Green Visa, Golden Visa, that allow real estate investors, skilled workers, freelancers, and self-employed to sponsor themselves. It is this openness that draws the UAE to a diverse range of applicants, from professionals to investors.
Before applying for a UAE residence visa, the required documents need to be prepared. These would normally include:
Photocopies of the passport
Submission of a completed visa application form
Recent passport-sized photographs
Proof of health insurance
A photocopy of the Emirates ID.
Apart from this, you may need other documents depending on your visa type. For example, investors may need proof of property ownership while employees may need an offer letter.
The first step to acquiring a residence visa is to arrive in the UAE on an entry permit or an entry visa. This entry visa allows you to remain in the country for a short while as you obtain residency. It is valid for 60 days, which is long enough to undergo medical tests and submit the required documents. Also, it depends on the purpose of your stay, either for work, investment, or sponsorship by family.
A medical examination is a mandatory requirement for all resident visa applicants 18 years and above. It is conducted at an approved medical facility and tests for certain specified medical conditions.
The test will take a few days, and you will need a successful medical report before proceeding to the next step.
Emirates ID is the UAE's official resident ID card. It is provided by the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship and is given for the same duration as your residence visa is valid.
You will need your passport, visa copy, and proof of residence, such as a tenancy agreement. You will also be asked to undergo biometric testing, including fingerprinting and an iris scan. An Emirates ID is needed to get access to government services, a bank account, and to complete official payments.
Once you have sent in your entry permit, medical reports, and application for Emirates ID, your sponsor can proceed to make the final application for the residence visa.
You are now eligible to obtain your Emirates ID and enjoy residency benefits.
There are several ways to get a residence visa in Dubai:
Employment-Based Visa
: Your employer sponsors your visa while you are working in Dubai.
Property Investment (Golden Visa):
Investing in a Dubai property worth at least AED 2 million can grant you a 10-year Golden Visa.

Entrepreneurs can apply for an investor visa and sponsor their family members.
Golden Visa for Professionals:
Available to top-tier talents, investors, and high-end individuals.
Remote Work Visa:
For employees who work for foreign companies but wish to live in Dubai.
Retirement Visa:
For those aged 55 and older who meet financial requirements.

Securing a UAE residence visa starts with selecting the appropriate type of visa based on your needs, like work, investment, entrepreneurship, or family sponsorship. Next, you prepare the required documents, including residence evidence and medical insurance. Candidates aged 18 and above must go through a medical fitness test and a security check. Once you are approved, you receive your Emirates ID, and you are done.
You can check your UAE residence visa status online via the official ICA Smart Services portal for most emirates or the GDRFA website for Dubai. By providing your application number or passport number, you can check the status of your visa, including whether it is approved, pending, or in progress.
To get an online printout of your residence visa, visit the
ICP Smart Services platform
, specifically the website:
smartservices.icp.gov.ae, log into your account, and download your visa application. You may print the visa copy, preferably in PDF format. This proves useful in saving a copy of your visa details digitally.
In 2025, obtaining a Dubai residence visa remains a straightforward process for investors, professionals, and families, provided you meet the eligibility requirements and prepare the necessary documents. Whether through employment, entrepreneurship, or property investment, the UAE offers multiple visa options that open the door to long-term residency and its many benefits, including access to world-class infrastructure, tax-free earnings, and an exceptional quality of life.
For those seeking a seamless path to residency, property investment—particularly in luxury developments—offers both a lifestyle upgrade and a secure visa route. Partnering with an experienced developer like DarGlobal ensures not only access to prime real estate but also expert guidance throughout the visa process, making your move to Dubai both smooth and rewarding.
Getting a UAE residency visa is a fast process. It generally takes only 2 to 10 working days from the time the documents are received and the medical evaluation is done.
Yes, you can apply for a residency visa without having a job in the UAE through real estate investment, company setup, family sponsorship, or some self-sponsorship visa categories.
A residence visa permits long-term residence and offers several residency benefits like the right to work, education, etc., while a visit visa permits short residence for tourist or short business stays.
You can track your UAE visa application status online through the ICA Smart Services portal or GDRFA website using your passport number or application number.
Yes, you can sponsor your family on a UAE residence visa if you are eligible on the basis of income and accommodation. It can include your spouse, children, and parents.
The cost of a UAE residence visa in 2025 varies depending on the type of visa. It is usually around AED 3,000 to AED 7,000, which includes application fees, medical check-up, and Emirates ID.
For an investor residence visa, you must invest in real estate of a minimum worth of AED 2 million or meet other investment requirements as specified by the UAE authorities.
title: How to Get a Residence Visa in Dubai 2025: Requirements, Process & Documents

text:
Dar Global completes transfer of its ordinary shares to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category on the UK FCA Official List.
DarGlobal Becomes First Saudi Company to Transfer to Equity Shares in Commercial Companies Category on the London Stock Exchange
London, United Kingdom / Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Dar Global PLC, a Saudi-born international luxury real estate developer, proudly announces the completion of its transfer of ordinary shares from the Equity Shares (Transition) category to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category of the Official List of the UK Financial Conduct Authority (the “FCA”). The transfer became effective at 08:00 BST on September 8, 2025.
This achievement marks a historic milestone as Dar Global becomes the first-ever Saudi Arabian company, and the first from the wider Middle East, to complete such a transition on the London Stock Exchange’s Main Market.
The transition is more than a technical shift: it represents the maturing of Dar Global’s journey from its origins in Saudi Arabia to becoming a listed international champion, carrying the Kingdom’s ambitions into global markets. Aligned with the goals of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, the move emphasizes the Kingdom’s ability to nurture homegrown enterprises that operate at the highest international standards while contributing to the global economy.
Dar Global CEO, Ziad El Chaar, said:
“Dar Global was born in Saudi Arabia and has grown into a company that represents the Kingdom on the world stage. This transition is a landmark moment, not just for our company but for Saudi enterprises, showing they can thrive internationally while advancing the goals of Vision 2030. Today, we stand as proof that Saudi ambition can set new standards in global markets.”
Dar Global is also pleased to confirm that Rothschild & Co acted as the company’s sole sponsor and financial adviser for the transition, bringing its global expertise and trusted advisory to support this historic achievement.
With this milestone, Dar Global continues its mission to bring Saudi innovation, ambition, and excellence to international markets—reinforcing both its Saudi identity and its global reach.

DarGlobal plans to launch Trump Plaza Jeddah in second collaboration with the Trump Organization, following the success of Trump Tower Jeddah

• USD 1 billion landmark development set to rise along King Abdulaziz Road in the heart of Jeddah

second Trump-branded development in Saudi Arabia, following Trump Tower Jeddah launched in 2024
Jeddah, Saudi Arabia; 29 September 2025–
Dar Global (LSE: DAR), the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, has announced its second collaboration in Jeddah with The Trump Organization, and plans to launch Trump Plaza Jeddah. The project represents the second Trump-branded development in Saudi Arabia, following the launch of Trump Tower Jeddah in December 2024.
Strategically located along King Abdulaziz Road in the heart of the city, Trump Plaza Jeddah is valued at over USD 1 billion and will transform the skyline with a world-class mixed use community. The development will include premium residences, serviced apartments, Grade-A office space, and exclusive townhouses. At the center of the masterplan will be a Central Park-inspired green spine, a landscaped park running the length of the development, anchoring the residences and serviced apartments and bringing the essence of Manhattan to Jeddah.
Designed to redefine urban living in Saudi Arabia, Trump Plaza Jeddah integrates living, working, and leisure into one seamless destination. It will feature offices adjacent to serviced apartments and premium residences, creating a community where people can live and work in one place. Thoughtfully designed home offices will be incorporated as an extension of private residences, while a premium retail courtyard and a curated mix of F&B concepts will enrich the lifestyle offering.
Eric Trump, Executive Vice President of The Trump Organization, commented
"We are honored to expand our footprint in Saudi Arabia with the Trump Plaza Jeddah. This project embodies our vision of excellence by blending world-class hospitality, modern living, and dynamic business environments. Together with Dar Global, we are creating a destination that will set a new benchmark for prestige and innovation in the Kingdom."
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, added:
"Trump Plaza Jeddah is a pioneering concept in Saudi Arabia and one of the most ambitious developments Dar Global has undertaken to date. By combining residential, serviced, and office components with a Central Park-inspired landscape, we are delivering a unique lifestyle destination that reflects both Manhattan’s vibrancy and Jeddah’s strategic role as a cultural and commercial hub."
Trump Plaza Jeddah will become a defining destination for the Kingdom’s evolving real estate landscape, further elevating Jeddah’s role as a center for premium living and international investment.

DarGlobal opens office in China in a bid to usher in global growth
DUBAI, UAE
Riyadh, KSA; February 5, 2022:
DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, continues its dynamic growth momentum by announcing the opening of its office in Beijing, China. The announcement is in line with the DarGlobal’s strategic expansion and builds on spreading the leading Saudi Arabian brands globally.
DarGlobal’s Beijing office will serve multiple functions to allow for joint ventures between DarGlobal and leading Chinese real estate developers for the Chinese and the Saudi market, further increasing and facilitate collaboration between Saudi Arabia and China and enhance investment and knowledge sharing opportunities. The office will primarily promote cooperation and partnerships within the real-estate and technology sectors to exchange and implement global best practices in these respective industries.
DarGlobal recently appointed Guo Jiancheng as General Manager for DarGlobal’s office in Beijing to lead the company’s operations in China. Following the announcement Jiancheng commented: “Over its 27-year history in Saudi Arabia DarGlobal has pioneered a distinctive approach to development, introduced new technologies, and raised the benchmark for the real-estate and technology sectors in the Kingdom. With this expertise and industry know-how, the company is well-positioned to take this knowledge and creativity to a global level and promote it as best practice. By entering into the Chinese market, DarGlobal is also well positioned to enhance relations between the Kingdom and China across multiple fronts.”
DarGlobal’s office will act as a hub to support Chinese companies and investors seeking expansion, company formation and investment opportunities in the Kingdom. By providing access to required information, permits, legal and financial knowledge, as well as support on partnerships and other requirements, DarGlobal is making entry into the Kingdom more accessible.
Likewise, the office will support Saudi Arabian companies to explore expansion opportunities and gain entry into the Chinese market. Furthermore, DarGlobal will encourage other areas for mutual collaboration, especially in tourism and cultural exchanges.
Starting in 2021,DarGlobal has embarked on a global expansion drive starting with the announcement of its Sidra project in Bosnia last March, followed by the launch of two luxury co-branded towers in the United Arab Emirates in collaboration with luxury fashion brand, Missoni, and hypercar manufacturer, Pagani Automobili, respectively. The company also announced expansion into the Qatari and Omani markets through premium residential and commercial projects.

text:
When you think of luxury automotive brands such as Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani, Bugatti, etc., The first thing that comes to mind is elegance and prestige.
Tierra Viva: An Example of How the Automotive Industry is Shaping Luxury Real-Estate
When you think of luxury automotive brands such as Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani, Bently, Bugatti, etc., the first thing that comes to mind is elegance, prestige, exquisite design and a worthwhile level of convenience that is simply exclusive and distinctive. However, when you think of real estate, you mostly think of the comfort that might be void of vision or brand identity.
The luxury automotive industry has been dedicated over the past few years to introduce a new design perspective and change the worldwide view of real-estate design, taking it from dull and uninventive to avante-garde, futuristic, and innovative, so let’s take a look into Darglobal’s project that this ideology has inspired.
Tierra Viva: Design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
Tierra Viva is more than just a name. It is precisely chosen to reflect what it truly means: connecting to nature and soil and becoming one with your surroundings. It means Earth comes to life.
Now, imagine if, in its true sense, it is combined with the level of elegance, unique and well-curated design and opulence that Automobili Lamborghini provides. Now that you have the mental idea, you no longer have to imagine.
DarGlobal
has collaborated with the Italian brand on this project to bring it to life and make this dream a reality.
How did Automobili Lamborghini inspire Tierra Vivas's design?
Automobili Lamborghini, founded in 1963, is the pinnacle of luxury sports cars made of futuristic lines and ingenious technology. An Italian masterpiece that is still headquartered in Sant’Agata Bolognese, where it all began.
With DarGlobal’s experience in creating luxury properties and Automobili Lamborghini’s design philosophy, a strategic collaboration is formed that is driven by shared values of excellence, quality and innovation as described by Stephan Winkelmann, Chairman and CEO of the Italian sports car brand.
Thanks to incomparable craftsmanship and passion, the true essence of their DNA is represented in this futuristic and elegant architectural project, which is complemented with interiors inspired by the design of super sports cars. This project promises distinction and uniqueness, with only 53 exclusive lavish villas considered an architectural prodigy.
Tierra Viva offers three distinct villa styles: six-bedroom Diamante, five-bedroom Zafiro, and four-bedroom Esmeralda, all of which sit on different elevations and provide views of the Mediterranean. Each Villa has its garage, a rooftop pool, several outdoor living areas, and a large garden. The interior design will be finished in high-end materials, inspired by the sports car’s signature look, with leather furnishing, polished marble floors and expansive glazing that draws attention to the view.
Further details are yet to be disclosed as the project is due to be finished by the end of 2026. Still, the collaboration is fruitful as
Automobili Lamborghini
shares DarGlobal’s commitment to producing exceptional results with meticulous attention to detail, as Ziad El Chaar, Dar Global’s CEO, said.
Tierra Viva’s Prime Location in Benahavis
Nestled in the breathtaking Costa del Sol region, this project boasts a prime location in the charming village of Benahavis. Known for its stunning landscapes, rich cultural heritage, and luxurious lifestyle, Benahavis is the perfect destination for those seeking a blend of natural beauty and high-end living. With its idyllic setting and proximity to the coast, this residential complex offers residents a truly exceptional living experience.
This project, designed by Automobili Lamborghini, is located in the heart of Benahavis and is only 15 minutes away from Marbella, a vibrant city with numerous stylish clubs, enticing nightlife, restaurants, and hotels, as well as shopping areas, exclusive marinas, and breathtaking beaches.
Tierra Viva
is located in the hills of Los Jaralillos, just minutes from the Mediterranean coast and close to 12 golf courses, numerous Andalusian villages, and Puerto Banos.
Nevertheless, it is surrounded by the natural beauty of the Costa del Sol. The region is known for its stunning landscapes, including rolling hills, lush valleys, and majestic mountains. Benahavis is nestled in the foothills of the Sierra de las Nieves Natural Park, a protected area that offers a haven for outdoor enthusiasts. The Tierra Viva residents can easily access the park and explore its numerous hiking trails, mountain biking routes, and picnic spots. The park is also home to a diverse range of flora and fauna, providing residents with a unique opportunity to connect with nature and experience the beauty of the Andalusian countryside.
DarGlobal is taking us on a trip to the future by collaborating with luxury automobile brands, such as Automobili Lamborghini, to elevate real-estate design to the next level; it’s a transformative ride into the evolving landscapes of tomorrow, and Tierra Viva is the perfect example of this new approach. The automobile industry’s effect on real estate is ever-growing, so fasten your seatbelts for a journey into a future where luxury and innovation converge, elevating lifestyle to unprecedented heights.
title: Tierra Viva: An Example of How the Automotive Industry is Shaping Luxury Real-Estate - DarGlobal

DarGlobal’s expansion into Saudi Arabia to benefit from growing international interest in the Kingdom’s real estate market
DUBAI, UAE
13 November 2023
– Dar Global, the luxury international real estate developer, is pleased to announce that it is strategically expanding its geographical presence to include Saudi Arabia given several promising opportunities that have been presented and which are currently being evaluated by the management team. The Group will continue to focus on its strategy of delivering high-end, bespoke investment opportunities to affluent and internationally mobile customers.
The Group has grown its portfolio from one property development in 2017 to its current 11 active projects in the UK, Spain, UAE, Oman, Qatar and Bosnia. The Group’s current portfolio GDV stands at US$5.0 billion (as of 30 June 2023).
One of the key drivers of the expansion is the Kingdom’s Vision 2030 plan to diversify its economy away from being a largely energy-based one. As part of this plan, Saudi Arabia is undertaking giga projects in the real estate and hospitality sectors on an unprecedented scale, these projects aim to attract the affluent international clientele and build global appeal in the Kingdom.
The Group will also benefit from its parent company, Dar Al Arkan’s, established presence in Saudi Arabia with a 29-year track record of delivering high quality real estate projects in the Kingdom. While Dar Al Arkan will remain focused on a domestic customer base, Dar Global will be able to leverage Dar Al Arkan’s significant Saudi market knowledge and local relationships, in areas such as planning, development and construction.
Dar Global will use a similar business model to that used in other international markets, differentiating its properties through partnerships with highly desirable luxury brands to develop unique second homes and investment properties for high-net-worth customers, specifically targeting those who are looking to participate in the unprecedented growth expected in the Kingdom over the coming decade.
With the tourism sector set to become a key pillar for the diversification of Saudi Arabia’s economy, the Group also anticipates compelling opportunities to develop hospitality assets, in line with the recent announcement of its ground-breaking partnership with Dolce & Gabbana in the Maldives.
Commenting on the news, Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global said:
“As Saudi Arabia looks to diversify its economy and grow its population in line with the ambitious Vision 2030 plan, it is a hugely exciting time to be entering the Kingdom’s real estate market. Saudi Arabia has an ambitious real estate and hospitality project pipeline. This provides significant opportunity for us to participate in luxury real estate opportunities where we are well positioned to promote and sell these projects internationally.”

DUBAI, UAE
Muscat, Oman; 16
March 2023:
Dar Global, the renowned international luxury real estate developer, has officially launched the sales of AIDA, one of Oman’s most significant premium mixed-use real estate projects directly by the sea, located just 10 minutes from Downtown Muscat. AIDA is set to redefine luxury living, offering a unique landscape with stunning elevated sea views of over 130 meters above sea level.
The 3.5 million square metre property, perched atop a hilltop, provides breathtaking views, immersive experiences, enchanting residences, facilities, and spectacular outdoor landscapes. AIDA’s master plan was designed to ensure innovative standards by adopting architectural foundations and utilising rich natural surroundings. Most importantly, AIDA is being developed sustainably, fully respecting and preserving the area’s topography and unique environmental features, with homes integrating seamlessly within the cliffs.
Designed to reimagine the concept of place creation and built in unison with its natural surroundings, AIDA represents one of Oman’s largest urban developments. The project is a ground-breaking initiative that will set a new standard in the region, further elevating Oman’s stand globally as a sought-after tourist, residential, and investment destination.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, commented on the sales launch: “
AIDA builds on our strategic aspiration of regional and global expansion through unique, high-quality developments that cater to a discerning clientele of global citizens. With the sales launch of this master project, we anticipate a strong response from the community of international investors, creating an even stronger resonance around Oman’s persona as a world-class destination.”
Dar Global’s AIDA project is a joint venture with Omran Group, the Sultanate’s executive arm for tourism development, to advance Oman’s real estate market in line with the country’s Vision 2040. The project is part of Dar Global’s collaboration with the Trump Organization and is poised to offer an unmatched luxury experience to both tourists and residents. This ambitious project is expected to drive tourism in Oman and bolster the country’s property market, supporting the goals of Vision 2040. By combining the expertise of Dar Global, Omran Group, and the Trump Organization, AIDA promises to set a new standard for luxury living in Oman and beyond.
About Dar Global
Dar Global is the international real estate arm of Dar Al Arkan, a 28-year-old real estate development company operating across the entire industry’s value chain with innovation and technology at its core. Leveraging its extensive experience and understanding of the industry, Dar Global focuses on developing elegantly designed residences catering to the second and vacation homes market in central locations in the Middle East and Europe. The company is fast-growing its portfolio across the world with developments in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Qatar, Oman, Bosnia, the United Kingdom (UK), and Spain. Some prominent projects include Urban Oasis tower in collaboration with Missoni, Da Vinci tower with interiors by Pagani, Les Vagues residences by Elie Saab, and the W Residences Dubai – Downtown. Missoni and Dar Global launch residential development project in southern Spain
DUBAI, UAE
15 September 2023:
Missoni and Dar Global, an international real estate development company, have announced the launch of “Marea, interiors by Missoni”, an exclusive residential development project near the Finca Cortesin hotel and golf club, a short walk from the center of Marbella and from the marinas of Puerto Banuìs and Sotogrande, in southern Spain.
The project, curated by the creative director of the Missoni home collection Alberto Caliri with the supervision of Rosita Missoni, represents the second partnership between the brand and Dar Global and involves the construction of a real estate complex of 18,500 square meters with two, three and four apartments rooms. The co-ownership, fenced and equipped with premium security services, will also offer a state-of-the-art gym, an infinity pool, a tennis court and play areas dedicated to children.
“We are delighted to collaborate with Dar Global on the Marea real estate project, interiors by Missoni, and are thrilled to furnish these incredible apartments with the finest fabrics and design, which will give the Mediterranean residences a unique and original finish. Our creative team came together to design bespoke luxury interiors that perfectly fit into the natural environment surrounding the apartments,” said Livio Proli, CEO of Missoni.
Marea, interiors by Missoni is the second project by Dar Global launched in Spain in the last three months, after the ultra luxury villas in Tierra Viva and Benahavis, in June this year.
“We are thrilled to partner with world-renowned fashion brand Missoni and offer exclusive homes in the beautiful landscape of southern Spain. The project has something in store for everyone: from the splendor of the unforgettable golf course of Finca Cortesin, to the golden beaches and dunes of Estepona, all against the backdrop of a breathtaking Mediterranean. This is the second project launched in Spain this year and we are immensely proud to present these unrivaled luxury homes in one of the most sought-after locations in Europe to our internationally traveling clientele,” commented Ziad El Chaar, managing director of Dar Global.

WLFI plans to tokenize Trump International Hotel & Resort, Maldives with Securitize and DarGlobal, expanding its branded real-world asset strategy.
World Liberty Financial to Tokenize Trump International Hotel & Resort, Maldives, in Partnership with DarGlobal and Securitize
PALM BEACH, FL
Broader WLFI Strategy to Tokenize Real-World Assets Begins with Flagship Hospitality Development
World Liberty Financial (“WLFI”) has today announced plans to tokenize Trump International Hotel & Resort, Maldives, in partnership with Securitize, Inc. a leading platform for tokenizing real-world assets, and DarGlobal PLC (LSE: DAR), an international luxury real estate developer. This initial offering reflects WLFI's broader strategy to design, structure, and distribute WLFI-branded tokenized real-world asset offerings.
Trump International Hotel & Resort, Maldives is a flagship luxury hospitality development by DarGlobal, created in collaboration with The Trump Organization, and scheduled for completion in 2030. The resort is set to feature approximately 100 ultra-luxury beach and overwater villas.
The initial tokenized offering aims to provide investors with exposure to a prime Maldivian hospitality asset underpinned by a globally recognized brand. Investors will gain exposure to the underlying asset’s performance, including both potential income distributions and changes in value, within a regulated securities framework.
“We built World Liberty Financial to open up decentralized finance to the world. With tokenized real estate, we’re now extending that access to what we do best,” said Eric Trump, co-founder of World Liberty Financial. “For the first time, everyday investors can gain access to an iconic property like Trump International Hotel & Resort, Maldives and can be part of its success. We're excited about future tokenized offerings as we bring more world-class assets on-chain.”
“Real estate has been one of the hardest asset classes to tokenize effectively,” said Carlos Domingo, Co-Founder and CEO of Securitize. “We believe the first scalable on-chain real estate products will be globally sought-after properties issued with compliance, governance, and market structure in mind. That’s exactly what this partnership with WLFI is designed to deliver.”
“This marks a breakthrough for real estate investment,” said Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal. “Together, we are rethinking how global investors can access, trade, and ultimately gain liquidity in high-quality real estate as it is being developed. WLFI brings a global network of active investors to our properties, by expanding participation and unlocking new pathways toward liquidity in global capital markets.”
The initial offering is expected to be issued on supported public blockchains, with plans to enable access via select third-party partners and wallets, subject to applicable requirements. The parties also plan to support additional on-chain utilities, including the ability for eligible users to collateralize their holdings and borrow through WLFI Markets, where permitted by law.
To learn more and join the waitlist, please visit:
https://securitize.io/alternative-assets/MALD1

text:
In the late 1960s, Dubai Airport used to operate from 07:00 to 13:00, handling just a few hundred passengers a day. After 13:00, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors at 13:15 and take the keys with him. Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M - and extraordinary leap in one generation. But as transformative as aviation has been for opening the Gulf to the world, the region is now entering a new era of mobility, driven by land connections within the GCC.
The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
How Rail Is Reshaping the Region Into One Connected Market of Opportunity
In the late 1960s, Dubai Airport used to operate from 07:00 to 13:00, handling just a few hundred passengers a day.
After 13:15, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors and take the keys with him.
Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M — an extraordinary leap in one generation.
But as transformative as aviation has been for opening the Gulf to the world, the region is now entering a new era of mobility, driven by land connections within the GCC.
The Trains Are Coming
One rail announcement after another is transforming six separate markets into one connected region:
- Riyadh–Doha high-speed rail
~2 hours of travel, 10M+ passengers expected, 30K new jobs, ~$30B in economic impact.
- UAE domestic rail (Etihad Rail)
Linking 11 cities as of 2026. Abu Dhabi to Dubai in 57 minutes, with a future high-speed train cutting that to 30 minutes.
- UAE–Oman corridor (Hafeet Rail)
Connecting Abu Dhabi to Sohar in ~100 minutes, transforming both passenger movement and freight.
All of this feeds into the 2,100 km GCC Railway, which by 2030 aims to create a single passenger experience that feels like domestic travel.
What This Means for People & Business
When borders become this frictionless, behavior changes. Millions of air passengers now have tempting alternatives.
Tourism spreads
- Dubai residents can finish work on Friday and enjoy dinner in Muscat.
- Families in Doha see Riyadh as a two-hour weekend trip.
- Standalone trips evolve into multi-city Gulf experiences.
Business accelerates
- Morning meetings in Riyadh, back in Abu Dhabi by afternoon.
- Supply chains reorganize around rail hubs.
- Companies hire across the GCC as commuting replaces relocation.
At this scale, mobility turns the GCC into one integrated economic system — because practically, it becomes one.
Early Connectivity Bets That Set the Stage
This vision for interconnectivity was laid down years ago:
- Saudi–Oman highway (2021)
Cut 16 hours of travel through the Empty Quarter.
- King Fahd Causeway (1986)
Linked Saudi Arabia and Bahrain and today moves 30M+ passengers a year.
These were early signals of a region thinking and acting as one. What’s different now is scale and timing: complementary systems being built simultaneously, with major links completing within this decade.
Design for the Network, Not the Node
For real estate, investment, policy, and beyond, the shift is fundamental. You’re no longer designing for a single location, but for access to an entire connected Gulf of opportunity.
This aligns with DarGlobal’s Live All In philosophy: living across markets and borders, supported by a level of connectivity that’s actively under construction.
If this is how far the GCC has already travelled, imagine what the next chapter holds.
In times like this, you either get on board — or watch the train leave without you.
title: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap

Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “We are excited to partner with Sacyr Construction, recognised for their expertise and experience in delivering high-quality infrastructure projects, as we embark on developing the next phase of Tierra Viva, the architectural crown in our luxury real estate portfolio. The Future of Real Estate in KSA: Trends and Opportunities
The real estate market in Saudi Arabia is experiencing an unprecedented transformation, fueled by the goals laid out in its
Vision 2030 program
. By implementing government reform, launching strategic infrastructure projects, and encouraging more investment opportunities, the Kingdom is on its way to becoming a key global player and leading real estate market. At DarGlobal, we lead the way in the KSA real estate market by creating luxury residential and commercial developments to meet Saudi Arabia’s future potential. Our landmark developments, such as the
Trump Tower in Jeddah
and
Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad
in Riyadh represent the emerging trends shaping the industry.
In this blog we will discuss the future of real estate in the KSA and the trends that will decide the market's fate and the investment opportunities, making it one of the world's most attractive real estate markets.
Current State Of The Real Estate Market In Saudi Arabia
The Saudi Arabian real estate market is experiencing a rapid change influenced by economic shifts and government-led initiatives.
Real Estate Demand & Growth:
The need for affordable housing remains significant, although a recent lifting of Saudization policies has reduced the number of expatriate residents. However, the government’s commitment to increasing homeownership rates has driven structural reforms and initiatives, leading to a steady rise in housing supply.
Vision 2030 & Infrastructure Development:
With Vision 2030 focusing on economic diversification efforts and lowering dependence on oil, the real estate sector stands to gain as one of the key beneficiaries.
Foreign Investment & Market Confidence:
Although foreign direct investment (FDI) fell sharply in 2024, the National Investment Strategy aims to attract SAR 388 billion in FDI by 2030. With regulatory reforms opening Saudi Arabia’s real estate market to foreign investors, investment opportunities are surfacing in the residential, retail, commercial, and hospitality sectors.
Key Trends Shaping The Future Of Real Estate In KSA
Here are some of the key trends to watch for in the real estate market in KSA.
Vision 2030: A Catalyst for Growth
Vision 2030 transforms Saudi Arabia into a global investment hub, encouraging local and international investors to participate in its real estate growth. Important Elements of Vision 2030 that impact real estate are:
Infrastructure Expansion:
Major urban developments are underway to accommodate the country’s growing population.
Higher Transparency:
Better regulation makes property transactions more seamless and safer for investors.
Investment Incentives:
Tax benefits, financing options, and ownership reforms encourage global investment.
With developments like Neptune Villas in Riyadh, DarGlobal is well-placed to deliver on this vision of luxury living space in highly sought-after locations for both local Saudi nationals and international investors.
The Rise Of Smart Cities
Projects like the Trump Tower in Jeddah further advance Saudi Arabia's position as a hub of smart cities. These cities integrate:
AI (Artificial Intelligence) & Automation:
Enhancing urban planning and efficiency.
Renewable Energy:
Reducing environmental impact with sustainable power sources.
High-Tech Living:
Offering smart homes, digital connectivity, and futuristic infrastructure.
This integration positions Saudi Arabia as one of the world's most progressive
real estate markets
, appealing to investors looking for sustainable, modern, technology-backed developments.
Sustainability & Green Real Estate
Through its commitment to the Saudi Green Initiative, the Real Estate sector is being transformed by encouraging:
Building Energy Efficiency:
Solar panels, smart energy management, water conservation
Eco-Friendly Materials:
Sustainable construction materials
that reduce environmental impact
Green Spaces And Urban Planning:
Integrating parks, gardens, and eco-friendly infrastructure.
DarGlobal’s projects reflect this shift towards sustainable luxury. By integrating green building practices into developments such as Trump Tower Jeddah, we are helping to mitigate energy costs and deliver long-term value for investors and residents.
Mixed-Use Developments On The Rise
Saudi Arabia is transitioning towards mixed-use holistic lifestyle communities, offering residential, commercial, and leisure facilities. Examples include:
King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD)
: An important financial centre with a combination of office spaces, housing, and entertainment.
Diplomatic Quarter, Riyadh
: A bustling urban neighborhood with business, retail, and lifestyle amenities.
These new developments cater to modern professionals and their families who yearn for convenience and a high-end urban lifestyle. Neptune Villas, for example, provides luxury, high-end living in an urban setting where everything is at your doorstep.
PropTech: The Future Of Real Estate Transactions
A revolution in property technology (PropTech) is sweeping through Saudi Arabia’s real estate sector. Some of its key advancements include:
Virtual Property Tours
: For international investors who want to progress their search without travelling.
Blockchain Transactions:
Ensuring secure and transparent real estate deals.
AI-Powered Analytics:
Investors can also gain insights from data analytics powered by AI.
With these advancements, investing in luxury projects such as Trump Tower Jeddah is simpler and more efficient than ever.
Opportunities For Investors
The evolving Saudi Arabia housing market offers lucrative
investment opportunities
, especially in the high-growth cities of Riyadh and Jeddah.
Riyadh: A Hub For Luxury Real Estate
Riyadh, the capital city, is seeing a massive expansion and has a burgeoning demand for luxury properties. Neptune Villas is a perfect example of this, featuring stunning design by the Mouawad and world-class facilities in a central location in North Riyadh. Investors can expect:
High Rental Yields:
Demand for premium housing
Increasing Population:
More demand for upscale housing.
Commercial & Hospitality:
Accelerated real estate development in the commercial and hospitality sectors.
Jeddah: A Coastal Investment Destination
With its prime location on the Red Sea, Jeddah is emerging as a luxury real estate hotspot. Developed by the high-end luxury property developer DarGlobal, Trump Tower Jeddah is poised to be a destination landmark with:
Seafronts with unrivaled views & iconic architecture
Close to Commercial & Recreational Centers
Luxury Amenities & Exclusive Living
With Jeddah cementing its business and tourism hub position, investment in high-end developments such as Trump Tower Jeddah offers significant potential for long-term return.
Future Outlook And Real Estate Predictions
With the megaprojects and diversification efforts spurred on by Vision 2030, the long-term outlook for Saudi Arabia's real estate market is very bright. Although the recent drop in Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) inflows reveals short-term variability, the long-run trend points towards robust recovery and growth. The National Investment Strategy’s target of
SAR 388 billion
in foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows by 2030 speaks to investor confidence in the Kingdom’s regulatory reforms and development programs.
Future landmarks, such as EXPO 2030, the FIFA World Cup 2034TM, and giga-projects like Trump Tower Jeddah, will further redefine new urban dynamics and drive tourism. The real estate market statistics in Saudi Arabia are predicted to create greater opportunities across the residential, commercial, retail and hospitality space, further positioning Saudi Arabia as a premier investment opportunity in the region.
Conclusion
As Saudi Arabia continues its transformation under Vision 2030, the future of the real estate market offers unparalleled opportunities. At DarGlobal, we are shaping the future of luxury real estate in Saudi Arabia. Our projects, from the luxurious
in Riyadh to the iconic
, stand at the forefront of luxury living, pioneering developments, and attractive investment opportunities.
Whether you are an investor seeking high returns on investment property or a buyer interested in finding world-class living space, right now is the time to strike the deal.

DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai
DUBAI, UAE
Urban Oasis by Missoni brings the Missoni lifestyle and Miami vibes to the city
The AED 800 million tower is situated in the heart of the city on the Dubai Water Canal
Riyadh, KSA; October 6, 2021:
DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the Urban Oasis residential tower in Dubai in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, known for its bold colours and iconic zigzag motifs, stripes, and wave patterns.
The launch of the prestigious AED 800 million development marks two significant firsts for both the companies: DarGlobal’s regional expansion with its first project in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and the Arab world’s first ever bespoke Missoni-inspired living spaces designed by the fashion brand’s MissoniHome line dedicated to interiors, decor, and furnishings.
Urban Oasis is situated in the heart of the city directly on the Dubai Water Canal in close proximity to Downtown Dubai’s top attractions such as Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, and many other premium lifestyle locations. The deluxe homes of Urban Oasis offer spectacular and uninterrupted views of the Dubai Water Canal, making the tower a true urban oasis within the bustling city.
Construction of the tower is currently underway and is set to be completed before the end of 2023.
Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Real Estate Development Company, said:
“The project’s location is in one of the most sought-after in the city, and we’re happy to have our first flagship development in the UAE situated in the heart of Dubai. The Dubai Water Canal is one of Dubai’s most attractive areas for homebuyers, and given its proximity to Downtown Dubai, Urban Oasis assures the best that the city life can offer, making it the ideal place to live. Working with Missoni is a clear indication of our continued dedication to providing our clients and investors with the highest standards of luxury living, while being completely unique compared to anything else on the market.”
Livio Proli, CEO, Missoni, said:
“We’re delighted to be working with DarGlobal on the Urban Oasis project, our first in the region, and are excited to be furnishing these incredible apartments with the finest fabrics and Miami inspired design, which will give the homes a unique and original finish. Our creative team has come together to design bespoke luxury interiors that perfectly complement the apartment’s urban surroundings. The Dubai real estate sector continues to grow and we’re relishing being a part of a development that has so much to offer.”
The stunning Urban Oasis in collaboration with Missoni is one of the best representatives of Italian fashion and contemporary design excellence around the world. It consists of 38 floors of high-end one, two and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom penthouses with luxury interiors from MissoniHome.
The unique penthouse apartments, which are accessible via a private elevator, come fully fitted with high-end Missoni fixtures and décor elements. The immaculately designed one, two, three apartments come in varying sizes and offer unique levels of five-star living, increadible water-front views and a closed kitchen.
Residents will also have access to luxury facilities and services. The tower features a swimming pool, a children’s play area, car parking, an equipped gymnasium, and 24/7 conceirge and security service.
Expanding the DarGlobal brand to international markets as a testament to the success of Saudi companies in delivering unique projects in new markets. It comes at an opportune time with Expo 2020 starting in October 2021, which will underline the investment potential in Dubai.

DarGlobal appoints Edrafor Emirates for enabling works on the Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai advancing the landmark project on Sheikh Zayed Road.
DarGlobal Awards Enabling Works Contract for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai to Edrafor Emirates LLC
Dubai, UAE
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the enabling works contract for the Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai to Edrafor Emirates LLC, marking a key milestone in advancing construction of this landmark development on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance of Downtown Dubai.
Introduced in April this year, Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai is set to become a new global icon, bringing together world-class hospitality, luxury residential living, and The Trump – an exclusive members-only private club designed for a select community of discerning global residents. The 80-floor tower will stand 350 metres high and feature Dubai’s highest outdoor pool, two ultra-rare penthouses inspired by New York’s Trump Tower on Fifth Avenue, and sweeping panoramic views of Burj Khalifa.
Edrafor Emirates LLC will undertake the enabling and foundational works required to prepare the site for full construction. The scope includes ground engineering, deep enabling systems and logistical mobilization to ensure the premium standards required for a development of such scale and luxury.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, said: “Dubai continues to attract global investors seeking exclusivity, architectural distinction and world-class hospitality, and Trump International Hotel & Tower embodies these qualities. The transition into site execution is an important step, reinforcing our commitment to delivering a landmark development that will stand among the most prestigious addresses in the region.”
General Manager of Edrafor, Pierre Fayad, commented: “We are proud to be appointed to deliver the enabling works for this remarkable project. Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai stands among the most ambitious developments in the city, and we are committed to executing the foundational works to the highest international standards. With our technical expertise and longstanding track record on complex regional developments, Edrafor Emirates will ensure a precise and timely start to the construction journey, setting a solid benchmark for the works that follow.”
As Edrafor Emirates begins full mobilization on site, DarGlobal will continue to advance construction activities and release project updates in line with key milestones. The tower is designed to elevate Dubai’s luxury real estate and hospitality landscape, attracting global investors, international residents, and members seeking an unparalleled level of exclusivity.

DUBAI, UAE
Worth 1 billion AED, The W Residences Dubai – Downtown brings elegant, prominently positioned homes with access to luxury amenities
Residents can step into the heart of the action, and back into their private world at the W Residences Dubai – Downtown
Limited number of 384 exclusive units with stunning views of Downtown Dubai
Riyadh, KSA; February 25, 2022:
DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the W Residences Dubai – Downtown in the bustling heart of Dubai, offering hotel-inspired living at one of the most sought-after addresses in the world. The 1 billion AED development is anticipated to mark the first standalone residences in the world under the iconic lifestyle W Hotels brand.
W Residences Dubai – Downtown, which will be managed by Marriott International is situated in the prestigious Downtown Dubai with uninterrupted, spectacular views of Burj Khalifa, the tallest man-made structure in the world, The Dubai Fountain, Dubai Opera and Old Town Dubai. The tower is in close proximity to the many premium and world-famous lifestyle destinations that the city has to offer.
Stepping away from the action-packed city, residents enter their own oasis of exclusivity and private space with beautifully crafted interiors, exquisite finishes, the finest services and exceptional amenities. Each residence has a unique design and purposeful layout that ensures each home is spacious, elegant and appeals to the needs of discerning clientele.
Construction of The W Residences Dubai – Downtown is currently underway and is estimated to be completed by December 2025.
Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said:
“Our experience in delivering high-end co-branded homes with global brands like Elie Saab, Versace, Roberto Cavalli, Pagani and Missoni puts us in a unique position to always bring the best, most desirable residential spaces to our customers. The W Residences Dubai – Downtown sets a new standard for extraordinary hotel living in the heart of a bustling city like Dubai catering to clientele who like to be close to the action but have their own luxurious private space close by. The Residences’ architecture, interiors and amenities is a truly what makes it a distinct, stand out tower in the midst of many other high-rises. This our third project in the Downtown Dubai area and I believe it’s a unique and fulfilling location to own your dream home.”
Jaidev Menezes, Vice President, Mixed-Use Development – Europe, Middle East & Africa, Marriott International commented:
“We are delighted to work with DarGlobal to launch this residential development under the W brand. With its vibrant design and impeccable service, W Residences Dubai – Downtown will be a great fit in Dubai’s iconic Downtown district.”
The architecturally stunning tower consists of a limited number of 384 exclusive, high-end residences with state-of-the-art appliances and fittings to compliment the exquisite interiors and give residents modern, functional, and elegantly appointed homes. Additionally, short terms rentals are prohibited to preserve the tower’s standards, ensure greater comfort and exclusivity, and maintain a higher property valuation.
Residents will live the W lifestyle at W Residences Dubai – Downtown which will offer luxury amenities dedicated to residents and their guests, turning every moment into a truly memorable experience. FUEL – the W brand’shigh-energy, social take on wellness will allow residents to focus on mind and body, will be complemented by an infinity outdoor swimming pool with views of the iconic Burj Khalifa with an outdoor terrace that features a lounge and dining area, as well as the FIT Fitness Centre and a spa. The Residences will also feature the Living Room lounge – a modern take on the standard lobby.
Residents will also have access to the W brand’s signature Whatever/Whenever® service which will provide residents with ultimate levels of convenience, round-the-clock in-Residence dining and catering services, laundry and dry cleaning, housekeeping, babysitting, fitness training and much more.
Other amenities include a media room with a cinema, gaming equipment and a chill-out space; a coworking space, meeting rooms, and a clubhouse where new connections spark over signature cocktails or a gourmet lunch.
The Residences are 20 mins away from Dubai International Airport, 10 minutes from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and a few minutes away from The Dubai Mall, one of the world’s largest shopping malls.
Expanding the DarGlobal brand to international markets as a testament to the success of Saudi companies in delivering unique projects in new markets. The developer is the largest non-governmental developer in the Middle East with AED30 billion in assets and a track record of delivery since 1994.
W Residences Dubai – Downtown is the developer’s third project in Dubai following the successful launches of Urban Oasis in collaboration with Missoni and Da Vinici Tower in collaboration with Pagani Automobili.
